testcase.system-out: Scenario: sweep-13 Create New Solid and change it to Join ✔ Given a disposable copy of the native fixture "fixtures/cad/sweep/block-outward-path.opd" is open ✔ And an existing solid has a circular profile on its top face ✔ And a straight path extending upward from the profile ✔ When Sweep is invoked and New Solid is selected ✔ Then Body Name shows Solid2 and OK is enabled ✔ When OK is clicked ✔ Then Sweep1 and Solid Bodies(2) appear ✔ When Sweep1 is edited to Join and accepted ✔ Then the raised boss remains and Solid Bodies(1) is shown
